## Active Work

**Currently In Progress:** None — **Phase 3a is at 3/6; US-030 shipped the intent matcher, the
riskiest story in the build**
**Blocked Stories:** none
**Next Up:** **US-031 — the thinking beat (2 pts)**: it latches `busy` and schedules the delay
through `useDashboard`'s one timer, and it is stagecraft rather than a query. Then US-032 hangs the
fallback panel on the matcher's `null` return, and US-033 gates the follow-ups, reading
`INTENT_REQUIRES_PARENT` plus the chip visibility US-029 already derives. The
component library is complete, so Phase 3b will be composition only. Five patterns are established
for the rest of the build to copy: a
good/bad reading arrives from `derive.ts` as data and is never re-derived in a component; a recorded
review decision is expressed structurally so it cannot be reverted by accident; a shared seam is
widened rather than forked when a consumer needs slightly more (`HBarTile`'s `children`,
`DeltaChip`'s `suffix`, `CardCaption`'s `section` placement); and **pre-authored copy is rendered
verbatim** — US-024 asserts byte-identical output, which is the guarantee every Phase 3b narrative
depends on; and **a debounce is state, not a clock** — US-028 consumes the question through a
mirrored ref and closes the field on `busy`, so the only pending timer in the app is still
US-015's `schedule`; and **state that can be derived is derived** — US-029's chip row is a pure
function of `sections`, which is what closed US-015's chip criterion with no reset code at all
